subject: RM_Dewblade
departures: blades are flat, broad strips standing rigidly edge-on, not thin arching grass leaves
every blade's tip narrows to a distinct drip-point, often with a bead of water at the tip
all blades in a tuft and across neighbouring tufts point the same way, in parallel rows like iron filings, not a random tangle
foliage is a muted grey-green, not a lush or yellow grass green
